# Layout review of the main board

The review of `hardware/sunbeam-em7000/main-board` by the [Layout review](../../../docs/board-design-method.md#layout-review) step of the board design method. Each round is recorded at its end, before any change to the board it calls for. Round 1 was judged by area group, by hand, with seven reviewer files merged into one round, because the review kit's shared context for this board is about 1.4 million tokens.

**Change after round 3 (2026-11-06).** Seven 0603 resistors changed value and nothing else: R607 and R608 from 330 ohm to 470 ohm, R791 to R795 from 100 ohm to 470 ohm, one part for all seven (UNI-ROYAL 0603WAF4700T5E, LCSC C23179), on the footprint `Resistor_SMD:R_0603_1608Metric` they already carried. The board file differs from round 3's commit 1f9f8357 in exactly 21 property lines, the Value, LCSC and MPN of those seven footprints (`git diff --stat`: 21 insertions, 21 deletions; a line-level diff shows no coordinate, net, layer, uuid, pad or attribute line changed), commit aeab20b5; the position file `kicad-cli pcb export pos` writes differs in the Val column of those seven rows and in no coordinate, rotation or side. Placement, copper, clearance, creepage, mask, paste and silk are therefore as round 3 judged them, and the layout items are unaffected: this is not a round, it adds no row and changes none of round 3's verdicts or findings. The layout review stays open as round 3 left it, with its findings' Closed by empty. The owner decided on the same day that no layout round 4 is run for this value-only change (DEC-MAIN-BOARD-RESIDUAL-RISKS-ACCEPTED-BY-OWNER, entry (z2)); the pre-order check is compared by rule with its baseline in its place, and the closing-round check of `task hw:review-history` reports the design files changed after round 3's commit, which it does on file paths and not on geometry.

### Plan and free pass

- Compared the Floorplan: the rule areas in the board file (layout-facts ZONES) and the `design-rules.md` region rows equal the plan's bounds and parts lists for all four regions (mains 6 rectangles, low voltage 9, analog sensing 10, digital 15). Departures from the plan: C406 and C414 outside `digital` (findings 1, 2).
- Compared the connector table against all 43 pin 1 positions: 42 within 0.35 mm of their row, JP101 10.4 mm off (finding 3, which BOARD-16 describes). The plan's J862 row now carries pin 1 at (122, 91.5) and the board matches it.
- Compared plan row TEST-1 and TEST-2 with the board: the row's own amendments (TP501/TP502 1.56 mm, TP824/TP832 2.01 mm apart; TP529 and TP833 on F.Cu) are exactly what I measured (findings 5, 6).
- Plan row DECOUPLE-5 (each snubber pair within 3 mm of the tab land, tracks no longer than 8 mm): C701 stands 3.45 mm and R706 0.56 mm from T701's courtyard, C711 0.65 mm and R716 0.56 mm from T711's; `PUMP_C_SNUB` measures 21.1 mm and `PUMP_S_SNUB` 30.6 mm of track. Row not met (finding 7).
- Plan row BOARD-2 (C304 and C305 10 mm or more from U302's tab): C305 (84.1, 35.1) is 6.9 mm and C304 (86.35, 37.3) 8.5 mm from the tab corner (77.85, 38.1), as the plan row itself admits (finding 8). The U302 tab land and B.Cu pour are another group's measurement.
- Plan rows I checked and found met: BOARD-7 (holes), BOARD-12 and BOARD-13 as above; BOARD-11 distances from the courtyard boxes: U401 21.3 mm from the module (needs 15), the converter cells U620, U621, U630, U631 at least 20.3 mm from K201 and 23.2 mm from U301 (the U601 parts such as C612 and R609 stand 5.3 to 6.8 mm from the module, which the row allows for the 125 degree C part); BOARD-16 JP101 at (38.5, 93.9) between F101 and K201 as stated (0.55 and 0.52 mm courtyard gaps).
- Free pass: nothing further seen on the tiles opened. Observations carried by other items: D526's designator text stands inside H2's courtyard (a `designator_astray` VIOLATION, MFG-9); D521, D522 and D526 stand about 1.2 mm from the bottom board edge (courtyard box), carried in finding 4.
- Not seen: tab receptacle and relay heights are not drawn (index.txt: no model), so BOARD-13 rests on the record's heights; no net view or layer view was opened.
- Coverage by measurement only: the placement of all 456 parts against the four regions (the check's `items_not_allowed` and measures.txt OUTSIDE lines), all 84 test point spacings and sides, all 43 connector positions, the four holes' copper clearances, all courtyard gaps around the hand-fitted parts. The 45 placement tiles were not opened (only r3c4); 7 images were opened in all.
- Departure to note: the views and placement tiles were rendered from commit N d685d6b5, not the head e16d375b; the head differs from N only by one removed dangling via, three do-not-populate footprint attributes and NT601's attributes. I measured from the checkout of e16d375b (layout-facts.txt and the board file), so no positions in this file depend on the N render, and none of those changes moves a part or a test point.
- (A-mains-safety) Compared the plan rows MAINS-1 to MAINS-5, CONN-1, BOARD-3, -4, -5, -6, -9, -14, -15, -16 with the board; the plan's own notes (MAINS-2 amendment naming AMC_DIN, POL_OUT, AMC_CS_PIN, BOARD-9 open note on C101 and RV101, CONN-1 deviation note) agree with what I measured; none of them closes a finding for me.
- (A-mains-safety) Checked by measurement only (no tile opened): B.Cu and In3.Cu/In4.Cu copper of the mains block against the strips and mains rectangles, the In2.Cu and In4.Cu pour edges, the B.Cu AMC_CS_PIN track, the 25 non-measurement-block clearance lines, and the 15 clamp-to-connector routes other than D503, D505, D570, D571.

Crops for T701 and net views for BOARD-10 were not rendered, so those items rest on measurement alone.
- (Owner, record) Correction to the mains-safety note above, made after the round: the 9.96 mm creepage from C601 pad 2 to K201 pin A2 (findings 1.42 and 1.75) was not reproduced. A read-only verification by an AI agent measured the pair at 10.414 mm round the slot arm by three methods (its own geometry, `board_geometry.route_length`, and `kicad-cli pcb drc` with a probe rule), and `route_length` itself returns 10.4136 mm for this pair, so the pre-order check not reporting it is correct, not a gap. The figures, commands and the reconciliation with `route_length` are in `pre-order-check-result.md`; the words "Owner's measurement" in the frozen findings 1.42 and 1.75 mean that verification, not a measurement by the owner. The verdicts and findings stand as the reviewer recorded them.

### Plan and free pass

- By-hand deviation: the kit's layout caller refuses this board (the shared documents alone are 4.95 million tokens against a 400,000 budget), so round 2 is judged by hand in six area groups with a fixed image menu; I could not open every tile the method names. I opened 9 images (placement-r3c4, assembly-top-r1c3, r2c2, r2c3, r5c1, r6c3, assembly-bottom-r2c2, 3d-angled, 3d-top), and cite only those.
- Covered by measurement only (layout-facts.txt and the board file, no tile opened for the whole board): FLOOR-5 pin 1 of the 43 connectors (only JP101's tile opened), TEST-1/TEST-2 on the 84 test points (only five of them seen), the CONN-2 diode and TQFN distances, BOARD-12 B.Cu clearance, BOARD-13 heights (from the record, since the tall parts are not drawn), and the FLOOR-1 region containment of all 456 parts.
- Compared with the plan: floorplan region bounds and part lists in design-rules.md against the Floorplan cells (equal); connector table against pin 1 positions (JP101 only departs, 10.42 mm); plan rows TEST-1 (2.5 mm pitch, plan's amendment records the two close pairs, unsigned), TEST-2 (amendment records the two F.Cu test points, unsigned), FLOOR-1/FLOOR-4 (C406 listed in `digital`, stands in `low voltage`), CONN-2 (the plan names only U620 and U621 as leadless and so does not count the 13 SOD-882 diodes).
- The plan's `+3V3A_FB` net carries a 27 mm branch to test pad TP303 (84.5, 54), measured only; I did not open a tile of it and raise no finding.
- Rendering limits (index.txt `NOT IN 3D`): K201, K731, K741, the tabs J101-J110, F101, F701, F711, F731 and J862 are not drawn in 3D, so no height of theirs is seen.
- (A-mains-safety) By-hand deviation: the kit's layout caller refuses this board (its shared documents alone are 4.95 million tokens against a 400,000 budget), so this round is judged by hand in six area groups with a fixed image menu; a reviewer cannot open every tile the method names. I opened 27 images in all (25 core, 2 classes tiles from the reserve) and cite only those.
- (A-mains-safety) Covered by measurement only (no tile opened): the right-hand connector column x 100-125 (all D5xx clamps for CONN-1), the pump triac lands at x 33-47, y 10-40 (BOARD-3), the POL_OUT and AMC_CS_PIN runs in the rectangle (62, 48.4)-(76, 76.5) (MAINS-2; AMC_DIN is on classes-r8c2), the In1 plane edge (BOARD-5, BOARD-6), and the strips of all eight bridging parts on layers other than F.Cu.
- (A-mains-safety) Compared with the plan: rows MAINS-1 to MAINS-5, CONN-1, BOARD-3 to BOARD-6, BOARD-9, BOARD-14 to BOARD-16 of layout-plan.md. The plan's MAINS-2 amendment already admits AMC_DIN, POL_OUT and AMC_CS_PIN in the rectangle, and CONN-1 and BOARD-9 carry unsigned deviations; I judged the layout against the rows as written, not against those admissions.
- (A-mains-safety) Check-tool notes, not board faults: SL_LINK (the slit from the board edge at (1, 102.6)-(32.75, 103.8)) is not a closed outline loop, so board_geometry's slot reader and the check's slot pull-back rule do not see it; inner-layer K201 pad 13 (LINE1) stands 0.7 mm from its wall. NT601's netless F.Cu bridge graphic reads as low-voltage copper beside mains pads in my pair search. Two unfilled NEUTRAL tap zone shells remain at (19.45-20.8, 76.2-76.8) on F.Cu and (48.45-48.76, 34.7-35.0) on B.Cu (no copper).
- (A-mains-safety) Free pass: nothing further seen on the tiles opened (silkscreen of FID2 and H1 overlaps its label text at the bottom left, assembly-top-r6c1, cosmetic and drawn on Fab, so not raised).
- (A-mains-safety) Reuse: MAINS-4, BOARD-3, BOARD-4, BOARD-14, BOARD-15, BOARD-16 took round 1's rows as leads and were re-measured on bc783865; MAINS-4 and BOARD-4 changed (no shortfall found at the U601 arm), the rest match.
- (B-power-decouple) By-hand deviation: the kit's layout caller refuses this board (the shared documents are 4.95 million tokens against a 400,000 budget), so this group was judged by hand on a fixed image menu and I could not open every tile the method names; I cite only tiles I opened and mark the rest `measured`.

### Plan and free pass

- Deviation (by hand, as the brief states): the kit's layout caller refuses this board, so the round is judged by hand in area groups with a fixed image menu; I opened 6 images (placement-r5c3, placement-r16c3, assembly-top-r5c1, assembly-top-r6c3, 3d-angled, 3d-top) and measured the rest from layout-facts.txt, the check report and the plan.
- Covered by measurement only: FLOOR-3 (the In1 ground plane by zone extent), FLOOR-5 (connector pin 1 against the table across all 43 rows), TEST-1 (spacing, pad size, tall-part distance for all 84 points), TEST-2 and BOARD-12/BOARD-13 (heights read from the plan record, not drawn in the views); the part-by-part region membership was judged from the check report's single items_not_allowed line and the script comparison of design-rules.md rows with the floorplan, not from the tiles.
- Plan comparison: the plan's floorplan table, `* region parts` rows (parts and bounds identical, 79 / 104 / 133 / 136), the connector table, the CONN-2 10 mm figure (TQFN clear) and the BOARD-7 hole points agree with the board; departures from the plan: C406 outside `digital`, JP101 pin 1 10.42 mm from its row (plan accepts it under BOARD-16, not a pass here), the TEST-1 row and TEST-2 row saying all test points are on B.Cu (two are on F.Cu).
- Tile-seen: on placement-r16c3 and assembly-top-r6c3 the reference text D526 overlaps the 'MountingHole' text of H2 at about (124, 125.8), which MFG-9 (designator_astray) and MFG-1 already ask about, so no separate finding.
- Not re-ran: LINE1 corner distances and the mains items (not in this group).
- (A-mains-safety) By-hand deviation: the kit's layout caller refuses this board, so the round is judged by hand in six area groups with a fixed image menu; I could not open every tile the method names, and every distance, count and area above is `measured:` from the board file (wtV, commit 1f9f8357) or the check report rather than read from a picture.
- (A-mains-safety) Parts of the board my items cover by measurement only: all copper and slot geometry outside the tiles named in each row (the whole right-hand column x 88-133 except assembly-top-r3c3, every inner-layer pour edge, the B.Cu and In1, In3 and In4 layers, and the U301, K201, K731 and K741 strips, which no crop covers); no crop-T701 exists, so BOARD-3 rests on the board file only.
